verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a customer data platform, so the axis applies. The pack documents one-off or event-driven mechanisms: Reverse ETL warehouse syncs, Audience syncs, Functions, and Messaging triggered by real-time events. None of them mentions a recurring schedule, cron-style cadence, or scheduled workflow, so there is no evidence of the capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
